options.name: FACTORY-AGENT-10 / Second Benchmark
options.purpose: Test whether multi-agent product benefit appears on a larger project
pros: Only way to resolve 'project too small' hypothesis
Could prove or disprove multi-agent definitively
AGENT-9-P2 already identified the exact hypothesis
cons: Risk of sunk cost if result is again no product benefit
Requires designing and executing new benchmark
options.condition: Only if user wants to definitively resolve multi-agent question

options.name: FACTORY-AGENT-PACK-PREP / Experimental Conditional Agent Pack
options.purpose: Package P1 as non-default experimental process/evidence layer
pros: Clear labeling prevents misuse as product quality tool
Allows real-world testing without full commitment
cons: May create false impression of product readiness
Without second benchmark, no generalization evidence
options.releaseBoundary: EXPERIMENTAL only. Must be labeled: NOT FOR PRODUCT QUALITY. Process/evidence tool only.
options.condition: Only if labeled EXPERIMENTAL, non-default, no product quality claim

options.name: FACTORY-AGENT-DIAGNOSTIC-PACK / Reviewer-Verifier Diagnostic Mode
options.purpose: Extract the most proven guardrail (Reviewer-Verifier) without full multi-agent implementation
pros: Lowest overhead of all multi-agent-derived options
Reviewer-Verifier has proven value: caught BLOCKED_BY_REVIEWER
Can be used standalone on any project
cons: Only extracts one piece of multi-agent value
Does not capture process/evidence framework benefit
May be too narrow to justify separate package
options.condition: Package as v0.4 add-on or standalone diagnostic tool. Lowest risk, highest proven value.

options.name: STOP Agent Line / Use v0.4 + real projects
options.purpose: Avoid further sunk cost; focus on v0.4 Factory Lite which is proven and operational
pros: Vanilla + v0.4 cover all proven use cases
cons: Reviewer-Verifier and negative controls frameworks are real value
Does not answer 'what if project is larger' question
options.condition: Too extreme. Keep proven pieces (Reviewer-Verifier, negative controls, v0.4). Cut only unproven pieces (7-agent, 10-role).

options.name: USER REVIEW / Pause for decision
options.purpose: Present options to user for value-based decision: product quality vs evidence/traceability
pros: Prevents agent from making strategic decisions
cons: User may not have full context without recommendation
options.condition: Present with a clear recommendation, not as an empty choice.

recommendation.rationale: Reviewer-Verifier diagnostic mode has the highest proven-value-to-overhead ratio. Package as standalone diagnostic tool. Present options A, B, C to user for strategic decision.
recommendation.secondary: OPTION_A if user wants definitive multi-agent answer
recommendation.recommendedNextPhase: User decision between FACTORY-AGENT-10 (second benchmark) or FACTORY-AGENT-DIAGNOSTIC-PACK (extract Reviewer-Verifier)
